## Model Performance (ROC)

The final evaluation shows strong performance across all news categories.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-roc-curves
#| fig-cap: "ROC Curves for AG News Classes (BERT Adapters)"
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

p = "../results/nlp_baseline/adapter_dim~256/learning_rate~0.0001/test_roc_curves.parquet"
df = pd.read_parquet(p)

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
sns.lineplot(data=df, x='fpr', y='tpr', hue='class')
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', alpha=0.3)
plt.title("Evaluation ROC (d=256)")
plt.xlabel("False Positive Rate")
plt.ylabel("True Positive Rate")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
```
